works.title: AI Waste Classification System
works.description: A CNN-based approach for automated waste type classification using deep learning. Trained and evaluated 5 CNN architectures (Xception, MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, DenseNet, AlexNet) on 6,000 images across 12 waste categories. Xception achieved 91.7% accuracy, demonstrating potential for smart recycling bins and automated sorting systems.
